content:
Unpopular opinion: your CGPA matters a lot less than you think, and your drafting ability matters a lot more than anyone tells you in first year.

I've seen toppers freeze on a simple legal notice. I've seen average students who could draft a clean plaint blindfolded because they actually practiced it, repeatedly, instead of only studying for exams.

Grades open one door, a good CV. Skill opens every door after that.

#LawSchool #LegalDrafting #LawStudents #CGPA #PracticalLaw
comment: The gap often appears when lawyers enter practice: knowing the law is expected, but knowing how to communicate it clearly to a client, court, or opposing counsel is what creates trust.
